question: Possiedo obbligazioni di un prestito emesso da una società, garantite da un pegno a favore di noi creditori. L'impresa è in difficoltà e la maggioranza dei titolari vuole proporre che un nuovo finanziatore riceva una garanzia che passi davanti alla nostra. Di regola la posizione della nostra garanzia può essere peggiorata senza il consenso di ciascuno di noi? E quale quota del capitale deve votare a favore perché questa decisione sia presa?

gold_facts.text: The rank of secured (pledge) bondholders cannot be changed without their consent.
That protection of rank is subject to the reserved power of the bondholders' community to grant priority to a new pledge.
Granting priority to a pledge created for new capital brought into the enterprise requires the consent of representatives of at least two thirds of the outstanding capital.

competing_candidates: Neighbouring Code of Obligations article requiring approval of such resolutions by the competent authority; the question now asks only about the rank rule and the majority needed to adopt the resolution, not about its binding effect on a dissenter.
note: Revised: narrowed from 'can they bind me if I object' to adoption of the resolution, so the authority-approval rule is not needed.

question: Ich habe ein Treuhandbüro mit meiner Steuererklärung beauftragt. Ohne mich zu fragen und ohne dass ich das erlaubt hatte, hat es die Arbeit an ein anderes Büro weitergegeben, das einen teuren Fehler gemacht hat. Haftet mein Treuhänder dafür so, als hätte er selbst den Fehler gemacht, und kann ich mich auch direkt an das andere Büro wenden?

gold_facts.text: An agent is liable, as if they were his own, for the acts of a person to whom he improperly delegated the mandate.
The principal may directly assert against the sub-agent the rights the agent has against that person.

competing_candidates: The preceding mandate article on the duty to perform personally (when delegation is permitted) and the general rule on liability for auxiliary persons; neither gives the principal's direct claim against the substitute.
note: Revised: removed the fact on authorised delegation, which the question rules out.

question: L'office des poursuites va vendre aux enchères un tableau de valeur qu'on m'a saisi à la demande d'un créancier. Or ce tableau est déjà mis en gage auprès de ma banque pour un prêt, et la banque passe avant ce créancier. Que se passe-t-il si personne ne propose un prix supérieur à ce que la banque doit encore toucher ?

gold_facts.text: In enforcement by seizure, the object is awarded to the highest bidder after three calls, provided the bid exceeds the total of the pledge-secured claims ranking ahead of the enforcing creditor.
If no sufficient bid is made, the enforcement ends with regard to that object.

competing_candidates: The next article, under which the office may refrain from realisation when a sufficient bid is evidently impossible.
The real estate realisation rules, which refer back to this principle; the question concerns a movable.
note: Revised: 'after at most three calls' corrected to 'after three calls' (DE/FR/IT).

question: Years ago my neighbour built a balcony that hangs over our garden, without any agreement with us. We saw it being built and never complained. Now we want it gone. Could a court instead let him keep it, and on what terms?

gold_facts.text: If the projecting structure was built without a right but the injured neighbour did not object in time although it was recognisable, the court may, where the circumstances justify it, grant the builder acting in good faith the real right to the structure or ownership of the land.
Such a grant by the court is made against fair compensation.

competing_candidates: The neighbouring rules on building on another person's land with one's own materials (allocation of land ownership) are similar but concern construction on, not projecting over, the land.
note: Revised: removed the fact on structures built with a real right (easement), which the question rules out.

question: Le curateur de mon oncle a conclu au nom de celui-ci un contrat important pour lequel il fallait obligatoirement l'aval de l'autorité qui surveille la curatelle, mais il ne l'a jamais demandé. Ce contrat engage-t-il quand même mon oncle, et d'après quelles règles juge-t-on ce qu'il en est ?

gold_facts.text: A legal act done without the required consent of the adult protection authority has, for the person concerned, only the effects that the law of persons provides when the consent of the legal representative is missing.

competing_candidates: The law-of-persons rules on acts done without the legal representative's consent (restitution, liability) give the detailed effects to which A refers.
note: Revised: removed the second clause that restated the article's rule; question now asks plainly about the effect and the governing rules. Same-language control item.

question: Notre coopérative d'habitation aimerait confier la conduite des affaires et la représentation à un directeur externe, qui n'est pas membre. Tous nos administrateurs habitent en France. Est-ce permis, qui doit pouvoir représenter la coopérative depuis la Suisse, et à quel registre des membres cette personne doit-elle avoir accès, avec quelles informations dedans?

gold_facts.text: The articles may authorise the general meeting or the administration to delegate management and representation to one or more managers, directors or other persons, who need not be members.
The cooperative must be able to be represented by a person domiciled in Switzerland who is a member of the administration, a manager or a director, and who has access to the register of members.
The cooperative keeps a register listing the name and surname or business name and the address of each member.

note: Revised: removed the fact on the register being accessible at any time in Switzerland, which the question does not ask.

question: Un'impresa mi ha rifatto il bagno, ma ci sono alcuni difetti non gravi: posso comunque usarlo e sistemarli non costerebbe una cifra esagerata. Posso pretendere che l'impresa li ripari gratis? E se non si muove, posso farli sistemare da un altro artigiano facendo pagare a lei il conto?

gold_facts.text: For defects of lesser importance, the owner may reduce the price in proportion to the loss in value or require the contractor to repair the work at its own expense if this is possible without excessive cost.
For repair at no cost, the rule allowing the owner to have defective work remedied by a third party applies by analogy.
Under that rule, the owner may set the contractor a reasonable deadline, warning that if it does not comply the repairs will be entrusted to a third party at the contractor's cost and risk.

competing_candidates: The contract-for-work rules on inspecting the work and notifying defects, and on the limitation of defect claims, which are preconditions rather than the remedies asked about.
note: Revised: removed the fact on damages for fault, which the question does not ask.

question: Ho inviato a una compagnia la richiesta di stipulare un'assicurazione sulla vita per la quale serve un controllo dal medico. Se la compagnia non mi risponde, per quanto tempo devo tenere ferma la mia richiesta e da quando si conta?

gold_facts.text: The proposer remains bound for four weeks if the insurance requires a medical examination.
The period starts when the proposal is handed over or sent to the insurer or its agent, and the proposer is released if the acceptance has not reached them before it expires.

competing_candidates: General Code of Obligations rules on how long an offer binds are topically close but the insurance-specific rule governs.
note: Revised: removed the fourteen-day general period, which the question rules out by stating a medical examination is required.

question: Eine Firma, die mir Geld schuldet, hat mit ihren Gläubigern vereinbart, dass ihr ganzes Vermögen verwertet und der Erlös unter uns aufgeteilt wird. Die Personen, die das abwickeln, kündigen nun eine erste Teilzahlung an. Muss man mir vorher zeigen, wie das Geld verteilt wird, und wie kann ich mich wehren, wenn ich die Aufteilung für falsch halte?

gold_facts.text: Before every payment on account, even a provisional one, the liquidators must make the distribution list (at least an extract of it) available to the creditors for ten days.
During that ten-day period the distribution list can be challenged by complaint to the supervisory authority.

competing_candidates: The bankruptcy articles on the distribution list and payments on account in bankruptcy; the question concerns a composition with assignment of assets, not bankruptcy.
note: Revised: fact reworded to hold in DE/FR/IT (IT says the extract is compiled and kept available, not sent); merged the ten-day availability into it.
